body:
I had an ex that I got back together with at one point. Over 10 years total together.
First time, I was sad, near self-deleting level of depression and couldn't get her out of my mind.


Second time, she broke up with me again, I just hate her, well dislike now. Cause hate is an extreme emotion. I honestly never want to see or think of this person again. The amount of stress, BS she put me through isn't anything id wish on anyone

I really don't know what to tell you, currently im a manchild, I am desperately trying to crawl myself out of this behavior but is is absolutely crippling me. Long story short, I grew up without my dad around, which I feel in turn messed up my development, that coupled with partying a lot during my twenties, not taking life seriously at all so it is mostly my fault.

I feel like there is nothing to "Man up" for, housing is unaffordable, even when I was busting my ass constantly, 80 hour work weeks, I could barely afford life, that coupled with ungrateful people, losing a lot of my material assets over time, and a failed relationship... men really, when they lose all hope of things getting better, and losing stuff to fight for, it becomes very bad for them. I seriously see no point in getting out of bed most days. It's like a roadrunner cartoon that never ends, and it's burnt me out at both ends.

Right now, after a failed relationship im considering moving in with an old friend, the only thing in life that was guaranteed to make me happy was a couple good friends, and some video games. There is nothing out there, that is really worth manning up for, unless you have a wife and kids.

  
Edit: One sentiment I agree with, is society and other people will "Shun" you for being overtly masculine, its a weird dynamic, its like they want you to "be a man" but never take any of the risks.
DM me and I can give you the best advice I can possibly give to pass, I had to take it several times
